# SYNESIS_E087 — Error

## Description

`[N]` prefix in the VALUES of `field_name` (ENUMERATED type) — the index is exclusive to ORDERED.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field 'field_name' is of type `ENUMERATED`, but its values use
  an index prefix (`[0]`, `[1]`, ...). The index exists to establish an
  ORDER among the values and only takes effect in `ORDERED` fields, where it is
  the data written in the annotations. In `ENUMERATED` there is no order: the data is
  the label itself, and the index would be ignored.
  Remove the `[N]` prefixes or change the field type to `ORDERED`.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **IndexOnEnumeratedValue**: `field_name`
